HCLTech to Establish AI Data Centre in Odisha

HCLTech announced plans to build a significant AI data centre and delivery hub in Odisha, with an investment of Rs 14,257 crore. The project is a collaboration involving the Odisha government and Sarvam AI. This initiative is expected to contribute to the development of a Sovereign AI Park.
